library.name: FB_Debounce
library.description: Filters a digital input: the output follows the input only after it is stable for the set time.

library.name: FB_AnalogScale
library.description: Scales a raw analog value to engineering units and flags a wire break.

library.name: FB_ForceWindow
library.description: Checks a measured compression force against a target and a tolerance band (percent).

library.name: FB_RampSpeed
library.description: Moves a speed setpoint towards the target with a fixed acceleration and deceleration.

library.name: FB_WeightControl
library.description: Keeps the average tablet weight on target by correcting the fill depth (PI control, slow and limited).

dfmea.cause: Powder property changed during the batch
dfmea.controls: Correction limit and an AtLimit flag shown to the operator
dfmea.actions: Alarm on AtLimit in the HMI

units.name: UN_TabletPress
units.description: Rotary tablet press TP-200: feeds, compresses and sorts tablets under force control.

dfmea.cause: Start command held during the reset
dfmea.controls: A start needs the Stopped state and a new command

equipmentModules.name: EM_PowderFeeding
equipmentModules.description: Keeps the dies filled: feeder speed follows the hopper level and the fill demand.

dfmea.controls: Empty flag stops the feeding
dfmea.actions: Plausibility check with the fill depth

equipmentModules.name: EM_Compression
equipmentModules.description: Compresses the powder: turret speed, fill depth and force control.

alarms.message: Force out of band, rejecting tablets
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the fill depth and the powder, then watch the trend.

dfmea.failureMode: Press keeps producing with the force out of band
dfmea.effect: Out-of-specification tablets reach the product container
dfmea.cause: Force check bypassed or not evaluated
dfmea.controls: Reject-all while the force is out of band
dfmea.actions: Verify the reject path with a challenge test

equipmentModules.name: EM_TabletDischarge
equipmentModules.description: Dedusts, counts and sorts the tablets: good tablets pass, rejected ones are diverted.

alarms.message: Reject gate did not follow the request
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the gate and the air supply.

dfmea.failureMode: Rejected tablet reaches the good container
dfmea.controls: Gate position feedback and a timeout
dfmea.actions: Challenge test with a known reject at each qualification

equipmentModules.name: EM_Guarding
equipmentModules.description: Allows the press to run only with the guards closed.

dfmea.failureMode: Press restarts by itself after the door closes
dfmea.cause: Automatic reset of the stop request
dfmea.controls: Reset requires a deliberate operator command

controlModules.name: CM_ForceFeeder
controlModules.description: Drives the paddle feeder that fills the dies with powder; speed follows the fill demand. Limited to 90 rpm for this customer powder.

alarms.possibleCauses: Drive tripped, motor protection open or broken coupling.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the drive and the motor protection, then reset.

dfmea.failureMode: Paddle wear, powder bridging in the die
dfmea.effect: Fill weight varies, tablets out of weight spec
dfmea.controls: Weight control, scheduled paddle inspection
dfmea.actions: Feeder fault alarm and weight trend

dfmea.effect: Feeder stops mid-batch, partial batch loss
dfmea.cause: Blocked fan or high ambient temperature
dfmea.controls: Motor thermistor in the drive
dfmea.actions: Trend the motor temperature in the HMI

controlModules.name: CM_HopperLevel
controlModules.description: Measures the powder level in the hopper and raises a refill request.

alarms.message: Hopper below 20%: call the operator to refill

alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the cable and the transmitter.

dfmea.failureMode: Level reads high while the hopper is empty
dfmea.controls: Plausibility check against feeder load
Wire break detection on the 4-20 mA loop

controlModules.name: CM_TurretDrive
controlModules.description: Runs the main turret with a ramped speed and a feedback check.

alarms.possibleCauses: Drive tripped, brake not released or guard open.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the drive and the brake, then reset.

dfmea.effect: Punch and die damage, batch loss
dfmea.controls: Torque limit in the drive, force overload stop

dfmea.effect: Drive overload and a stop at start-up
dfmea.controls: Drive checks the brake feedback before enabling
Drive temperature warning
dfmea.actions: Filter cleaning in the maintenance plan

controlModules.name: CM_CompressionForce
controlModules.description: Measures the pre-compression and main compression force and checks it against the target band.

alarms.possibleCauses: Fill too high or granule hardness changed.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the fill depth and the powder.

alarms.possibleCauses: Fill too low or feeder starved.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the feeder and the hopper.
Check the cable and the amplifier.

dfmea.controls: Periodic calibration
dfmea.actions: Calibration schedule in the maintenance plan

dfmea.controls: Wire break alarm and an independent drive torque limit

dfmea.effect: Real overload is read as the maximum value
dfmea.cause: Wrong amplifier range for the tooling
dfmea.controls: Range check at commissioning
dfmea.actions: Add a second independent overload channel

dfmea.cause: Cable routed on the moving frame
dfmea.controls: Wire break detection

controlModules.name: CM_FillDepth
controlModules.description: Positions the fill depth cam to set the powder dose, with a ready and range check.

alarms.message: Fill depth setpoint out of range

dfmea.controls: Weight control loop

dfmea.failureMode: Servo loses its position after a power loss
dfmea.controls: Absolute encoder and a homing check

controlModules.name: CM_DedusterBlower
controlModules.description: Runs the tablet deduster blower with a feedback timeout.

alarms.possibleCauses: Filter blocked or motor protection open.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the filter and the protection.

dfmea.effect: Powder on tablets and cross contamination risk
dfmea.controls: Differential pressure check in maintenance
dfmea.actions: Add a pressure sensor in a later version

dfmea.controls: Motor protection

controlModules.name: CM_RejectGate
controlModules.description: Diverts rejected tablets into the reject chute with a pneumatic gate.

alarms.possibleCauses: No air or valve coil failure.
alarms.possibleSolutions: Check the air supply and the valve.

dfmea.failureMode: Gate stuck in the good position
dfmea.effect: Rejected tablets reach the product container
dfmea.controls: Position sensors and a timeout

dfmea.effect: The gate cannot divert rejected tablets
dfmea.controls: Air pressure switch on the machine

controlModules.name: CM_TabletSensor
controlModules.description: Detects the tablet at the discharge chute, filtered against flicker, for counting.

dfmea.controls: Periodic cleaning
dfmea.actions: Add the cleaning step to the SOP

dfmea.cause: Sensor mounted on the moving chute
dfmea.controls: Debounce time and a mounting bracket
dfmea.actions: Compare with the turret revolution count

controlModules.name: CM_DoorInterlock
controlModules.description: Monitors a guard door with two channels and reports a discrepancy. Stops the turret when the door is open.

alarms.possibleSolutions: Replace the switch and check the wiring.

dfmea.effect: Press runs with the guard open
dfmea.controls: Two channels with a discrepancy alarm

dfmea.failureMode: Short circuit between the two channels
dfmea.effect: Both channels read closed with the door open
dfmea.controls: Pulsed channels (test pulses) in the safety relay
dfmea.actions: Use cross-short detection in the safety relay

controlModules.name: CM_LubricationPump
controlModules.description: Pulses the central lubrication pump of the turret on a timer. Specific to this customer machine.

dfmea.controls: Periodic refill in the maintenance plan
